name: menubar
title: Menubar
description: A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications that provides quick access to a consistent set of commands.
usageSnippet:
static const fileItems = [
  { value: "new", label: "New Tab", shortcut: "⌘T" },
  { type: "separator" },
  { value: "print", label: "Print…" },
] satisfies DropdownMenuItem[];

<Menubar>
  <MenubarMenu items=fileItems select(value) { /* ... */ }>
    <@trigger|triggerProps|>
      <button ...triggerProps>File</button>
    </@trigger>
  </MenubarMenu>
</Menubar>

examples.title: Basic
examples.source:
import Menubar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/menubar/menubar.marko";
import MenubarMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/menubar/menu.marko";
import type { DropdownMenuItem } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";

static const FILE_ITEMS = [
  { value: "new-tab", label: "New Tab", shortcut: "⌘T" },
  { value: "new-window", label: "New Window", shortcut: "⌘N" },
  { type: "separator" },
  { value: "share", label: "Share" },
  { type: "separator" },
  { value: "print", label: "Print...", shortcut: "⌘P" },
] satisfies DropdownMenuItem[];

static const EDIT_ITEMS = [
  { value: "undo", label: "Undo", shortcut: "⌘Z" },
  { value: "redo", label: "Redo", shortcut: "⇧⌘Z" },
  { type: "separator" },
  { value: "cut", label: "Cut" },
  { value: "copy", label: "Copy" },
  { value: "paste", label: "Paste" },
] satisfies DropdownMenuItem[];

static const VIEW_ITEMS = [
  { value: "reload", label: "Reload", shortcut: "⌘R" },
  { value: "force-reload", label: "Force Reload", disabled: true },
  { type: "separator" },
  { value: "fullscreen", label: "Toggle Fullscreen" },
] satisfies DropdownMenuItem[];

<Menubar>
  <MenubarMenu items=FILE_ITEMS>
    <@trigger|triggerProps|>
      <button type="button" ...triggerProps class="data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-accent-foreground focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground flex cursor-default items-center rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium outline-hidden select-none">
        File
      </button>
    </@trigger>
  </MenubarMenu>
  <MenubarMenu items=EDIT_ITEMS>
    <@trigger|triggerProps|>
      <button type="button" ...triggerProps class="data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-accent-foreground focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground flex cursor-default items-center rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium outline-hidden select-none">
        Edit
      </button>
    </@trigger>
  </MenubarMenu>
  <MenubarMenu items=VIEW_ITEMS>
    <@trigger|triggerProps|>
      <button type="button" ...triggerProps class="data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-accent-foreground focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground flex cursor-default items-center rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium outline-hidden select-none">
        View
      </button>
    </@trigger>
  </MenubarMenu>
</Menubar>
examples.description: Each `MenubarMenu` takes an `items` array of the same shape as the dropdown menu, plus its own `@trigger` body for the visible button.

examples.title: Checkbox
examples.source:
import Menubar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/menubar/menubar.marko";
import MenubarMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/menubar/menu.marko";

<let/showBookmarksBar=false/>
<let/showFullUrls=true/>
<let/strikethrough=true/>
<let/code=false/>
<let/superscript=false/>

<Menubar class="w-72">
  <MenubarMenu
    checkedChange(value, checked) {
      if (value === "bookmarks-bar") showBookmarksBar = checked;
      else if (value === "full-urls") showFullUrls = checked;
    }
  >
    <@trigger|triggerProps|>
      <button type="button" ...triggerProps class="data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-accent-foreground focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground flex cursor-default items-center rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium outline-hidden select-none">
        View
      </button>
    </@trigger>
    <@item type="checkbox" value="bookmarks-bar" checked=showBookmarksBar>Always Show Bookmarks Bar</@item>
    <@item type="checkbox" value="full-urls" checked=showFullUrls>Always Show Full URLs</@item>
    <@item type="separator"/>
    <@item value="reload" shortcut="⌘R" inset>Reload</@item>
    <@item value="force-reload" shortcut="⇧⌘R" inset disabled>Force Reload</@item>
  </MenubarMenu>
  <MenubarMenu
    checkedChange(value, checked) {
      if (value === "strikethrough") strikethrough = checked;
      else if (value === "code") code = checked;
      else if (value === "superscript") superscript = checked;
    }
  >
    <@trigger|triggerProps|>
      <button type="button" ...triggerProps class="data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-accent-foreground focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground flex cursor-default items-center rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium outline-hidden select-none">
        Format
      </button>
    </@trigger>
    <@item type="checkbox" value="strikethrough" checked=strikethrough>Strikethrough</@item>
    <@item type="checkbox" value="code" checked=code>Code</@item>
    <@item type="checkbox" value="superscript" checked=superscript>Superscript</@item>
  </MenubarMenu>
</Menubar>
examples.description: Use `<@item type="checkbox">` (or an `items` entry with `type: "checkbox"`) for toggleable options; drive `checked` from your own state and update it in `checkedChange`.

examples.title: Radio
examples.source:
import Menubar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/menubar/menubar.marko";
import MenubarMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/menubar/menu.marko";

<let/user="benoit"/>
<let/theme="system"/>

<Menubar class="w-72">
  <MenubarMenu radioChange(group, value) { if (group === "user") user = value; }>
    <@trigger|triggerProps|>
      <button type="button" ...triggerProps class="data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-accent-foreground focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground flex cursor-default items-center rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium outline-hidden select-none">
        Profiles
      </button>
    </@trigger>
    <@item type="radio" value="andy" radioGroup="user" checked=(user === "andy")>Andy</@item>
    <@item type="radio" value="benoit" radioGroup="user" checked=(user === "benoit")>Benoit</@item>
    <@item type="radio" value="luis" radioGroup="user" checked=(user === "luis")>Luis</@item>
    <@item type="separator"/>
    <@item value="edit" inset>Edit...</@item>
    <@item value="add-profile" inset>Add Profile...</@item>
  </MenubarMenu>
  <MenubarMenu radioChange(group, value) { if (group === "theme") theme = value; }>
    <@trigger|triggerProps|>
      <button type="button" ...triggerProps class="data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-accent-foreground focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground flex cursor-default items-center rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium outline-hidden select-none">
        Theme
      </button>
    </@trigger>
    <@item type="radio" value="light" radioGroup="theme" checked=(theme === "light")>Light</@item>
    <@item type="radio" value="dark" radioGroup="theme" checked=(theme === "dark")>Dark</@item>
    <@item type="radio" value="system" radioGroup="theme" checked=(theme === "system")>System</@item>
  </MenubarMenu>
</Menubar>
examples.description: Group `<@item type="radio">` entries with a shared `radioGroup` name for single-select options; `radioChange` fires with the group name and the newly selected value.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source:
import Menubar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/menubar/menubar.marko"; import MenubarMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/menubar/menu.marko"; import type { DropdownMenuItem } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";
<@trigger|triggerProps|> <@trigger|triggerProps|> <@trigger|triggerProps|> <@trigger|triggerProps|>
examples.description: Wrap the menubar in a `dir="rtl"` container for right-to-left layout and text. One gap versus upstream: `MenubarMenu`'s `Input` type does not declare the menu machine's `dir` prop, so passing `dir` to it is a type error — even though `<zag-machine from=input/>` would forward it to the machine (`MenuProps` extends `DirectionProperty`). Until the type declares it, only the static `dir="rtl"` wrapper flips this demo: text direction and logical-property layout, not floating-ui's own RTL placement flip.

examples.title: Compound (attr tags)
examples.source:
import Menubar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/menubar/menubar.marko";
import MenubarMenu from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/menubar/menu.marko";

<Menubar>
  <MenubarMenu>
    <@trigger|triggerProps|>
      <button type="button" ...triggerProps class="data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-accent-foreground focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground flex cursor-default items-center rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium outline-hidden select-none">
        File
      </button>
    </@trigger>
    <@item type="label">Actions</@item>
    <@item value="new-tab" shortcut="⌘T">New Tab</@item>
    <@item value="new-window" shortcut="⌘N">New Window</@item>
    <@item type="separator"/>
    <@item value="share">Share</@item>
    <@item type="separator"/>
    <@item value="print" shortcut="⌘P">Print...</@item>
  </MenubarMenu>
</Menubar>
examples.description: Use `<@item>` attribute tags on `MenubarMenu` instead of `items=` to compose the menu directly in markup — pass `type="separator"` for a divider or `type="label"` for a group label. Entries render in the order they are written. An item's text can come from either a `label=` attribute or a markup body, whichever you prefer.

attributes.name: inset
attributes.description: Upstream styling attr — indents the item to align with checkbox/radio items.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: `type: "checkbox" | "radio"` checked state (checkbox) or selected value match (radio).

attributes.name: radioGroup
attributes.description: Groups radio items — required for `type: "radio"` entries.

attributes.name: radioValue
attributes.description: `type: "radio"` entries only — this entry's value within its `radioGroup`.

attributes.name: subEntries
attributes.description: `type: "sub"` entries only — the nested submenu's own item list.

events.name: checkedChange
events.description: Fires when a checkbox item's checked state changes; receives its value and new checked state.

events.name: radioChange
events.description: Fires when a radio group's selected value changes; receives the group name and new value.

fields.name: inset
fields.description: Emits `data-inset` — indents the entry to align with icon-bearing siblings.

fields.name: radioGroup
fields.description: Groups radio items — required for `type: "radio"` entries.

fields.name: radioValue
fields.description: `type: "radio"` entries only — this entry's value within its `radioGroup`.

fields.name: subEntries
fields.description: `type: "sub"` entries only — the nested submenu's own item list. One level deep: a `type: "sub"` entry inside a submenu's own `subEntries` is not wired (same limit as menubar's submenu).
